title: Standalone Deployment Workflow
description: A six-step vis-network sequence taking a program from Thonny-attached execution to standalone autorun, with per-step commands and the three silent failure points flagged on demand.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
Embedded Systems
Deployment

learningObjectives: Summarize the ordered steps for standalone deployment
Diagnose which step was skipped from a failure symptom
Explain why these failures produce no visible traceback
prerequisites: Has run a program from Thonny with the board attached
Knows that import looks for a module by name

controls.label: Common failures
controls.purpose: Flag the three steps that fail silently

controls.label: Reset
controls.purpose: Clear flags and restore the default panel text

controls.label: Any step
controls.purpose: Show what it accomplishes, the command, and the common mistake

assumptions: Deployment uses either mpremote or Thonny's Save As; other tooling is not shown
limitations: Does not cover boot.py, frozen modules, or filesystem-corruption recovery

keyQuestions: Why do all three common mistakes produce the same symptom?
Which step would you check first given 'nothing happens on power-up'?
commonMisconceptions: That any filename will autorun, not just main.py
That code working under Thonny proves it will work standalone
assessmentOpportunities: Given a symptom, name every step that could be responsible and how to distinguish them
